row.proposed_rule: After remind / ask / tell someone, say the action as a verb before the thing: zakkreeni ajib 5ubez (remind me to bring bread), not zakkreeni 5ubez.
row.why: For 'Remind me to bring bread' he went from the command straight to the thing (ذكّرني خبز); Amal supplied the missing verb in English ('To bring.', PG-22) and he added a verb (59:14 ذكريني تجيبي). Same shape as GR-27 (laazem needs a verb), but no bucket covers 'remind me + verb', so PROPOSE.

rulings.why: r1's D10 row (missing verb at 59:09) is real: his sentence lacked the verb and Amal's English 'To bring.' was a voiced prompt that he acted on. r2's D10 row (تجيبي -> أجيب, B18) is a different slip in the same exchange and is the same as r1's D11 - ruled there.
